subject: Staggered hosted commit uplift & onboarding playbook
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@edgepulse.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-07-19T09:06:00-07:00
Subject: Staggered hosted commit uplift & onboarding playbook

Hi Lina —

Thanks again for the productive renewal conversation last week. As discussed, we put together a phased/"staggered" approach that lets EdgePulse increase hosted commit capacity while smoothing billing/rate impacts and preserving burst headroom. High-level summary: 

1) Phase 1 (months 1-3): +50% monthly commit (from 2.0M tokens/mo to 3.0M tokens/mo), same unit rates, 10% burst pocket available.
2) Phase 2 (months 4-6): +100% baseline commit (4.0M tokens/mo), apply new mid-tier rate band for >3.5M/month.
3) Soft throttle & grace: automated soft-throttle at 80% of baseline to trigger caching/batching suggestions; hard throttle only after agreed burst exhaustion.

Operational asks from EdgePulse: procurement signature, preferred effective date for Phase 1, and any internal PO/billing process. We attached a one-page playbook and a sample invoice run-rate.

Attachments: EdgePulse_Staggered_Onramp_20280719.pdf (summary), EdgePulse_MATP_redline_20280719.pdf (contract redline)

Next step proposal: If procurement signs by EOD Friday (Jul 21), we provision the buffer and schedule a 30-minute onboarding + traffic-smoothing call with CS on Monday Jul 24. Can you confirm who from procurement/legal should be on the loop?

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Account Lead — Hosted API
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: EdgePulse_Staggered_Onramp_20280719.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@edgepulse.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-07-20T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered hosted commit uplift & onboarding playbook

Hi Lina —

Quick answers and ops details below.

Proration: If Phase 1 starts mid-cycle we prorate the monthly commit on a per-day basis; example: starting on day 15 of a 30-day cycle => billed baseline = (15/30 * 2.0M) + (15/30 * 3.0M) for that first invoice. We can include explicit math in the SOW.

Burst pocket: We’ll reserve a 10% burst pool on top of the baseline for months 1-3 (approx. 300k tokens/month) and a separate replenish policy for unexpected spikes. Monetary cap: $2,500/month for burst overages during Phase 1, unless you elect to enlarge the pocket.

Soft-throttle thresholds: 80% (informational), 95% (apply adaptive batching and prefix cache eviction), 110% (burst charge applies). We will expose token usage metrics and an alert at each threshold.

Ops checklist (for SRE):
- API keys: create a new dedicated service key for onboard (rotate within 7 days).
- Alerts: enable token-usage Slack webhook (token_usage@edgepulse.slack.com).
- Cache: suggested default TTL 60s for chat-prefix cache; enable continuous batching with 50ms hold window.

Pricing excerpt (Phase pricing per token, simplified):
- Baseline 0–3.5M tokens: $0.0012/token
- Mid-tier 3.5M–7.5M tokens: $0.00095/token
- Burst (over mid-tier): $0.0015/token (capped by burst pocket)

If that looks okay I’ll produce a marked SOW and a DocuSign envelope today. Naomi/Marissa — please confirm the proposed onboarding call slots: Mon Jul 24 10:00–10:30 PT or Tue Jul 25 14:00–14:30 PT.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Phase1_pricing_example.xlsx)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>

Date: 2028-07-20T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered hosted commit uplift & onboarding playbook

Lina / team —

Operational notes from an engineering/ops perspective: we’ll provision the extra capacity in the hosted pool 48 hours before your Phase 1 effective date. A couple of clarifications that matter for SRE: 
- Token accounting: we will surface both live counters (rolling 1h, 24h) and monthly accrual counters.
- Proration visibility: Procurement will receive a sample prorated invoice preview 24h before billing period end.
- Rate-limits: we will not change per-second TPS limits for Phase 1; if you need higher TPS we can add a separate quota (quick turn).

I attached recent Q2 usage snapshots so you can validate the 10% burst sizing against peak windows.

Requested from EdgePulse: preferred Phase 1 start date (we can do Jul 25 or Jul 31) and the primary SRE contact for the onboarding call.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
